Class SlotLayout

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.containers.api.menu.SlotLayout
public final class SlotLayout extends Object
The slot layout of a CustomContainerMenu: which panels it has, which slot groups each holds, and how shift-click pairs them (§0067). Structure only; runs on both sides with the same declaration, so both build the same slots. 
CustomContainerMenu.builder(type)
    .panel("mymod:menu:main", p -> p.group("items", MY_CATEGORY, storage))
    .panel("mymod:menu:side", p -> p.group("extra", MY_CATEGORY, extra).hidden().toggleable())
    .build(syncId);
How each panel looks (its elements, style, placement, toggle key) is declared on the client with MenuKit's Panel.Builder: ClientMenu.of(MENU).panel("mymod:menu:main", p -> p.position(PanelPosition.main()).add(...)).

Namespace your panel ids

A created slot's address is keyed by (panel id, group id, index) and is global, not scoped by the menu, so two mods naming a panel "main" would share addresses and arm each other's slots. Name panels per mod: "mymod:menu:main".
